utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m glad we’re doing the repair drive, but I want to make sure we’ve got the schedule, tools, and drop-off plan sorted first.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I can help pull that together. Let’s nail down the schedule, list the tools we need, and set a clear drop-off spot so everything’s ready.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds good to me—can we set a specific time, list the tools, and confirm the drop-off spot before we tell anyone?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time is the repair drive, and what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Faye. I’m still waiting on the final time, but I’ll let you know as soon as I have it, and I’d really appreciate help spreading the word and keeping it around school pickup hours.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely — once you have the time, send it my way and I’ll help spread the word and keep it clear of pickup hours.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—just point me to what needs fixing, and I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Bo—I've only heard bits, but I’ll pass along the repair list as soon as I get it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect—send it over when you have it, and I’ll take a quick look.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to grab or fix?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s really kind of you, Leo. Could you help me sort the tools and check the loose fence panels?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Absolutely — I’ll sort the tools first and then check the fence panels. I can start now if that works.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Rey — if you can bring a drill, some screws, and maybe a couple work gloves, that’d be a huge help. I’m probably running a little late, but I’ll be there soon.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it — I’ll bring the drill, screws, and gloves. Take your time; I’ll see you soon.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll check the details first—what exactly needs repairing, and when is the drive happening?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m still gathering the list, but it’s mostly small household repairs and odds and ends. I’ll let you know the date as soon as I confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it—once you have the list and date, send them over and I’ll help sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the repair drive! I’m a bit foggy on the details, but I’m happy to help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Oren! I’ll send you the details and help spread the word—there’s a lot we can still fix up together.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Quinn. Send me whatever you’ve got, and I’ll do my best to pitch in and tell a few neighbors too.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—just let me know what’s needed and when.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — that’s wonderful. I’ll send you the list and timing shortly, and we can match you to a task that fits.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good, Rosa — I’ll keep an eye out for your list and timing. Happy to pitch in wherever I’m most useful.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t tracked the repair drive location yet, Mina, but I can help narrow it down if you’ve got a landmark or street name.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — do you remember which street it’s near, or any landmark beside it?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I don’t have the street yet, but if you tell me the nearest landmark, I can help pin it down fast.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate that. I’ll keep you posted if I hear anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Anytime, Vik — I’ll let you know if I hear anything useful. Hope the repair drive picks up soon.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Right — I meant to check on that. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm you’re bringing the extension cord and the toolbox?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yep, I’ve got the extension cord and the toolbox covered. I’ll bring them by.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Sam. Let’s keep it simple: could you help sort the donations, and then we’ll load the boxes by 3 o’clock?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can sort the donations and be ready to load the boxes by 3 o’clock.
